stateLabels.note: 10 shown of 24. Nobody can change their own roles, branches or status. You can only give a role whose rights you hold yourself. Every active staff member keeps exactly one primary branch. Only a Director can change a Director.

tools.label: How this is counted
tools.done: How this is counted: Weighted average cost per medicine per branch; a purchase receipt moves the average (value before plus the receipt's cost, divided by the quantity before plus what was received). Opening stock enters at the unit cost entered for it. Stock leaving (dispensing, treatment-room use and waste, write-offs, supplier returns, count losses) leaves at the average at that moment. Transfers leave one branch at its average and arrive at the same cost. Purchase order estimates are used when nothing was paid yet, and marked 'Includes an estimate' until that stock is gone. Stock with no cost enters at the current average; with no average yet it is counted apart and named, never valued at zero. Supplier credit notes do not move the average; the difference is shown under Losses.

tools.label: Print pack

tools.label: By status

tools.label: By Panel RM 943.50

tools.label: Statement rows · 11 of 14 matched

tools.label: Remove statement file

tools.label: Accepted claims · 27

extra: MC file added (demo). Up to 3 files, 5 MB each, until 14 days after the leave ends.

stateLabels.label: To decide
stateLabels.note: The same items appear in the Approvals inbox.

stateLabels.label: Roster this week
stateLabels.note: Cheras, week of 23 Nov · approved. Warnings never block a save.

stateLabels.label: Attendance today
stateLabels.note: Flags are worked out when the page opens and are never stored.

stateLabels.label: Staff files
stateLabels.note: Staff files: 51 people. Nobody manages their own file. HR never changes accounts, roles or branch assignments. Data is synthetic until the PDPA review.

stateLabels.label: Today per branch
stateLabels.note: "Enough" and "Short" are for today, by the roster planner's own rule. Minimums apply to every day. Leave never shows its type or reason. Read only.

stateLabels.label: This month by branch
stateLabels.note: Branch-local dates. Late and early count only after HR saved a grace period. Leave days are all types added together. No ranking and no score of any person.

stateLabels.label: Claim pay
stateLabels.note: Finance Officer or Director records a payment made outside KPOne. The payer is never the claimant or the approver. KPOne pays nothing.

stateLabels.label: Claims monthly
stateLabels.note: Paid in November 2026, grouped by the date the claim was paid. On screen only. To confirm with the clinic's accountant before real use. Staff-claim cash is never part of daily cash closing.

stateLabels.label: Overtime
stateLabels.note: One closed clock session each, inside the correction window. No money is worked out or shown here; pay is in Payroll. The decider is never the person.

stateLabels.label: Corrections
stateLabels.note: Oldest first. Approving adds an event; the original press is kept and still shows on Review. The decider is never the person and never whoever asked.

stateLabels.label: Leave settings
stateLabels.note: KPOne ships no leave types or entitlement figures; HR enters them. Each save is a new version. The yearly grant and carry-forward run only when a manager presses their button.

stateLabels.label: Attendance settings
stateLabels.note: Flags stay hidden until HR saves a settings version. KPOne ships no number; the overtime form suggests 1.5x, 2x, 3x, 40 h and 45 h.

stateLabels.label: Minimum staffing
stateLabels.note: Minimums apply to every day. A shortfall is a warning on the roster; it never refuses a save. Each save is a new version.

stateLabels.label: Claim settings
stateLabels.note: KPOne ships no category, limit or rule. Limits only warn; the approver decides. There is no partial approval.

stateLabels.label: Credentials register
stateLabels.note: Warnings only · nothing here stops clinical work. Soonest problem first. The clinic enters its own credential types; KPOne ships no list. Reminders show inside KPOne only, on the person's My roster and My attendance, from the type's "warn from" days. Nothing is sent.

stateLabels.label: Credential types
stateLabels.note: Entered by the clinic; KPOne ships no list. Records keep the version they were entered under.

stateLabels.label: Payroll · November run
stateLabels.note: November 2026 run · Ready to review · RM · 12 staff · pay date 25 Nov. To confirm with the clinic's accountant before real use. Synthetic data only. The Director's and the HR Manager's own pay stay outside KPOne in this version. Locums are paid under Locum statements. The Director approves, never the person who ran it. KPOne pays nothing and files nothing.

stateLabels.label: Locum statements
stateLabels.note: Approved shifts × the confirmed rate on each. KPOne works out each statement; payment is made outside KPOne and only recorded here. To confirm with the clinic's accountant before real use. Synthetic data only until the PDPA review.

stateLabels.label: Locum rates
stateLabels.note: A rate counts once a Finance Officer or the Director who did not enter it confirms it. It prices shifts from its start date. Nobody confirms a rate they entered.

stateLabels.label: SOPs
stateLabels.note: 10 published. A new file is a new version, read again by everyone it is for. "I have read and understood" becomes possible only after the person has opened the SOP (the server checks). Opens and acknowledgements are kept for good.

stateLabels.label: Memos
stateLabels.note: Published memos, newest first. Nothing is sent by email or message: people see memos here and on their Me page. Reading: open the memo and its PDF if it has one, then press I have read this. One read per person; a double press counts once. A read is kept even if the memo is later withdrawn or replaced.

stateLabels.label: Letters
stateLabels.note: Issued newest first. Printed, signed by hand and given in person. Nothing is sent. Nobody issues a letter to themselves; a letter to the Director or the HR Manager is issued only by a Director. Replace gives a new number and voids the old one as replaced; void needs a reason; both are kept.

stateLabels.label: Letter templates
stateLabels.note: HR writes each template in English and Bahasa Melayu with fixed placeholders only. KPOne ships no wording. A change is a new template version; issued letters keep theirs.

stateLabels.label: HR messages
stateLabels.note: Staff only · never patients. Messages never carry an amount, a reason or anything about patients. Over the monthly cap, KPOne skips the message and shows "Not sent: monthly cap reached". Page 1 of 6.

stateLabels.label: Message channels
stateLabels.note: What staff can be told: Leave decided · Roster published · Payslip ready · Staff claim decided or paid · Open shift confirmed (locums) · Sign-in code (OTP). Each person picks their own channels under My messages; they always see these inside KPOne too. Over the cap, KPOne skips the message and shows "Not sent: monthly cap reached".

stateLabels.label: Appraisals
stateLabels.note: Year-end 2026 · 1 to 5 per criterion · no total · no ranking · people alphabetical, never by rating. A Director signs off once the person has commented, or 7 days after sending; after sign-off nothing changes and no more comments can be added. Nobody signs off their own appraisal. A cycle keeps the criteria version it opened with.

stateLabels.label: Appraisal criteria
stateLabels.note: Entered by the clinic; KPOne ships none. A cycle keeps the version it opened with; a change makes version 3.

stateLabels.label: Incidents
stateLabels.note: HR reads every report. Patient-care reports are flagged for clinical review; a clinical review is recorded as a note and never changes the patient's record. Reporter shown as a staff number only. KPOne sends no reminder; overdue actions show here and on the report.

stateLabels.label: Discipline
stateLabels.note: Restricted · Director and HR Manager. Cases about you, or that only a Director may handle, are not listed. One outcome closes the case; it cannot be changed afterwards. KPOne never ends employment or changes a KPOne account, never shows a case on the staff file, the dashboard or any export, and never lets you open or see a case about yourself.

stateLabels.label: Job applications
stateLabels.note: From the public job form. Turning an applicant into staff stays with the account administrator. At phone screening, the daily check closes an application as Auto-rejected after 3 working days without a decision. Every CV open is recorded before the file is sent.

stateLabels.label: Job positions and settings
stateLabels.note: Each save is a new version. The applications privacy notice is a draft for the owner to approve; the public form stays off by default.

stateLabels.label: My HR
stateLabels.title: My HR
stateLabels.sub: Your own leave, attendance and claims · every staff member sees this
stateLabels.foot: You see only your own records. Nobody decides their own leave, claim or correction.

stateLabels.label: My leave
stateLabels.note: Your own leave. Nobody decides their own leave; an HR Manager's leave goes to the Director. The team calendar shows "On leave" or "half day" only.

stateLabels.label: My attendance
stateLabels.note: Server time only. Login, queue and consultation times are never attendance. One open session per person.

stateLabels.label: My claims
stateLabels.note: Up to 5 receipts each; the purpose is kept encrypted. Another person approves your claim and records its payment.

stateLabels.label: SOPs to read
stateLabels.note: Open the PDF first; then "I have read and understood" is possible. Your acknowledgement is saved for good.

stateLabels.label: My memos
stateLabels.note: Open the PDF first, then "I have read this".

stateLabels.label: My letters
stateLabels.note: Letters issued to you. Opening one is recorded.

stateLabels.label: My locum pay
stateLabels.note: Locums only: what a locum sees with their own sign-in, read only.

stateLabels.label: Staff directory
stateLabels.note: Everyone can see names, roles and branches. No personal details are shown here.

C0.title: Inventory

primary.label: New stock count
primary.done: count sheet opened. Blind count: the system quantity stays hidden while you count (demo).

C0.foot: Stock leaves only by a governed count, write-off, transfer or return. A held batch cannot be dispensed. Costs are shown to the Director only.

tabs.label: On hand
tabs.note: Usable stock by item. Open a row for its batches.

action.label: Count
action.done: count sheet opened for this item (demo).

tabs.label: Low stock and reorder
tabs.note: Suggestions use the last 30 days of use. A suggestion never orders by itself.

action.label: Add to PO
action.done: added to a draft purchase order (demo). The Director approves every PO.

tools.label: Clear ticks
tools.done: ticks cleared (demo).

tools.label: How it is worked out
tools.done: Average use a day × lead time, rounded up to whole packs and at least the supplier's minimum order. Where a maximum is set, the maximum is used instead of the reorder level. Estimated costs are shown only to a Director or Finance Officer.

tools.label: AI agent suggestions (Hana)
tools.done: opens the approval inbox (demo).

bulk.label: Request these
bulk.done: purchase request drafted for one location (demo). A request is for one location: tick suggestions of one location only. It is not sent to the supplier until approved.

tabs.label: On order
tabs.note: Items still on order, by line. The orders themselves are in Purchase orders.

tabs.label: Transfers
tabs.note: Branch requests go to the central store on Thursday. Receive what arrives; shortages stay open until someone else resolves them.

submit.label: Send request
submit.done: TR-0090 requested from Sungai Besi (demo).

tabs.label: Expiring and held
tabs.note: Expiring soon (each item's own alert window, 90 days unless set), expired on hand, and batches on safety hold.

action.label: Write off
action.done: write-off proposal started. Someone else approves it (demo).

tabs.label: Hana suggests
tabs.note: AI agent · checked at 07:00 · you decide. Approving records the decision only; it does not change stock.

action.label: Approve
action.done: suggestion approved. KPOne records the decision; it does not change stock (demo).

tabs.label: Deliveries to check
tabs.note: Deliveries and transfers that have arrived and wait to be checked in.

action.label: Check in
action.done: opens receiving for this delivery (demo).

tabs.label: Counts due
tabs.note: 12 counts due · 6 days since the last count. Stock leaves only by a governed count, write-off, transfer or return. Never counted first, then the oldest. Blind count: the system quantity stays hidden while counting.

action.label: Start count
action.done: count sheet opened (demo).

tools.label: Scan or type barcode
tools.done: scanned a box: its line is highlighted on the count sheet; type the count. A scan never fills the count by itself (demo).

tabs.label: By form
tabs.note: Items in stock · 142 · Cheras · usable stock only, patient returns left out. An item kept in more than one location is counted once here.

action.label: Show items
action.done: showing items of this form on On hand (demo).

tabs.label: Other branches need
tabs.note: What Cheras can spare for Puchong and Sungai Besi. Their need brings them up to their maximum (or reorder level); what we can spare is usable stock above our own level, less what is already waiting to be sent. The suggestion is the smaller of the two, in whole units.

bulk.label: Send request
bulk.done: stock request sent (demo). Tick suggestions for one branch and one of our locations at a time; it is approved and sent from this branch in Transfers and received by the other branch.

tools.label: Clear ticks
tools.done: ticks cleared (demo).

action.label: Send
action.done: sent as an ordinary stock request from the branch that holds the stock (demo).

tabs.label: Open differences
tabs.note: From earlier transfers into Cheras. Outcomes: arrived later, usable after inspection (both add stock), lost in transit, damaged, or sent in error, each with a reference. A CA Supervisor, Finance Officer or Director at Cheras resolves; never the person who received it.

action.label: Resolve
action.set: Resolved: written off · by you (not the receiver)
action.done: difference resolved by a different person (demo).

tabs.label: Batch holds
tabs.note: Cheras · 25 per page. Held stock cannot be allocated or dispensed. Placing or releasing a hold changes no quantity and creates no movement. stateLabels.label: Purchase orders
stateLabels.note: Cheras · newest first. 2 orders waiting for you · 1 part received. The person who prepared an order never approves it. Estimated costs are shown to the Director only. No payment in KPOne. On order lists the items; this tab lists the orders.

stateLabels.label: Receive delivery
stateLabels.note: Receiving PO-00318 from Supplier A · Delivery reference (DO no.) DO-2231 · received by Siti · 18 Nov, 09:52. 4 lines on this order · 2 ready · 2 need approval · 1,180 units counted. Stock for exception lines posts only after someone other than the receiver approves them. Rules: a delivery reference is required; every lot needs the real expiry from the box; accepted + quarantined + rejected must equal what arrived; a wrong item is rejected, never swapped in. Each lot records batch, expiry (from the box), accepted, quarantined, rejected and total paid for this lot (RM, optional).

stateLabels.label: Supplier invoices
stateLabels.note: Record the supplier's invoice against its purchase order. KPOne compares each line with what was ordered, what was received and what it cost (three-way match). Any difference waits for a Finance Officer or Director who did not record it. KPOne pays nothing: a matched or accepted invoice is ready to pay outside KPOne. Recorded by a CA Supervisor or Finance Officer; approved by a Finance Officer or Director. Invoice amounts are shown only to a Director or Finance Officer.

stateLabels.label: Supplier returns
stateLabels.note: Cheras. 1 ready to dispatch · 3 waiting for approval · 2 credit note to record · 11 returns this year. The approver is never the person who asked. Dispatch is the only step that moves stock and never takes it below zero. A credit note is a reference only.

stateLabels.label: Supplier price list
stateLabels.note: Pack sizes, prices and lead times per supplier and SKU. Prices are shown only to a Director or Finance Officer. Reorder suggestions use the preferred supplier's pack, lead time and minimum order.

stateLabels.label: Recalls
stateLabels.note: 2 active. A recall blocks named batches at every branch. It moves no stock. Stock is shown for every branch. A Director starts a recall; a Director or Finance Officer lifts it, never the person who started it. After a lift the batches can be used again at every branch, unless something else blocks them.

<div role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Confirm" style="width: 420px; max-width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px">
